reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs contain no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-inducement covenant binding Corio (the licensee/customer we represent); Exhibit D §5 is a staffing-assignment commitment, p0116 concerns IP/NDA covenants, §14.5 is standard independent-contractor language and §14.10 incorporates only the NDA and SOW.

Absence of any non-solicit on the Customer is exactly the playbook's preferred position for this presence-type rule, so no redline or counterparty comment is expected and none was proposed — the redline is identical to the original text.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable heuristics here because there is no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not undermine the compliance conclusion.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes the fallback position to hold if a personnel covenant is later proposed; retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
